item.title: Suspected ransomware attack disrupts cancer treatments, surgeries at Guadeloupe hospital
item.description: France’s national cybersecurity agency is investigating a suspected ransomware attack that impaired the computer systems of the University Hospital of Guadeloupe, forcing doctors to postpone surgeries, suspend some cancer treatments and revert to pen and paper.

When Valid Agent Actions Become a Security Incident: Governing AI Agents at Machine Speed
item.description: An AI agent can take a thousand actions before a person has time to read the first alert. That is useful when the agent is reconciling records, triaging incidents, or carrying out a tightly defined workflow. It is dangerous when a malfunctioning or manipulated agent can compound small, individually permitted actions into a material business or security event. Consider a finance-reconciliation agent.
